summary: Daniel Lamthach, 22, Utah ultrarunner set out Jul 16 or 17 from Molas Pass south of Silverton to climb the Trinity Peaks in the Grenadier range; extensive search found only his cell phone Jul 18 on the Elk Creek Trail east of the Animas River; remains missing.
location: Molas Pass / Elk Creek Trail / Trinity Peaks, Grenadier range, south of Silverton
responding_agency: San Juan County Search and Rescue
notes: Third runner swallowed up by the San Juan Mountains in a year; date uncertain (Jul 16 or 17); outcome fatality (presumed; never located).
